::: {#sol-expression-or-algorithm}

A function is the input-output relationship.
An expression is a string of symbols that denotes a function,
and many expressions denote the same one.
An algorithm is a finite list of steps that computes a function,
and many algorithms compute the same one.
So $a x^2 + b x + c$ is an expression: it names a function, and it is not an algorithm.

:::
